newsitem.title: USA: Mother decapitated, sons killed in domestic fight.
newsitem.headline: Mother decapitated, sons killed in domestic fight.

text.p: A 33-year-old mother was found decapitated and her two sons stabbed to death in an apparent domestic dispute involving the woman's husband, police said Monday.
Police sources said one of the children had been heard pleading for mercy when he called the 911 emergency number late Sunday. "Daddy, daddy, stop it!" the boy shouted.
Dispatchers traced the call to an apartment in a public housing project in New York's Queens borough. Officers removed the door to gain access and found the bodies.
Police found the woman's husband, Richard Timmons, 31, in the apartment. His wrists had been slashed in what appeared to be a suicide attempt.
The mother was identified as Anita Timmons and the boys as Aaron, 13, and Sharone, 7. The woman's head had been cut off with a knife and the boys had been stabbed several times each.
Richard Timmons, a subway track cleaner, has a history of domestic violence and already faces assault charges stemming from alleged attacks on his wife last year.
He was hospitalized for the cuts on his wrists and was in stable condition.
